description: This file contains a parser for CLDR number patterns, including pattern definitions, parsing logic, and related utilities for number formatting and rounding in Go.

classes.name: Pattern
classes.description: Holds information for formatting numbers based on CLDR patterns.

classes.name: RoundingContext
classes.description: Contains settings for how numbers should be rounded and converted to digits.

methods.name: RoundSignificantDigits
methods.description: Returns the number of significant digits to which a number should be rounded.

methods.name: RoundFractionDigits
methods.description: Returns the number of fraction digits to which a number should be rounded.

methods.name: SetScale
methods.description: Sets the RoundingContext to a fixed number of fraction digits.

methods.name: SetPrecision
methods.description: Sets the maximum significant digits for rounding.

methods.name: isScientific
methods.description: Determines if the pattern is in scientific notation based on MinExponentDigits.

methods.name: needsSep
methods.description: Determines if a separator is needed at a given position in the number pattern.

methods.name: ParsePattern
methods.description: Extracts formatting information from a CLDR number pattern string.
